title: A company driver says 'go ahead' to 380 dollars of found work; the call scores high and breaks a rule the scorecard cannot see
purpose: Story S4, the wrinkle behind her waiting team note. A driver of company account A3 phones about a car that is in for an oil change, asks for a noise to be looked at, and approves an axle at 379.64. The company's page says a driver cannot approve work over 300 dollars and the fleet contact is to be called. Nothing on the call is wrong by the scorecard: no auto-fail, 94.4.

scenario.job: in for an oil service; found: the right front CV axle (the boot is split and the joint clicks)

scenario.what_happens: Maya tells him the oil service is done and asks about a clicking on turns before he has raised it. He asks for it to be looked at. She gives the axle's price, what it covers and when it would be done; he says 'go ahead'; she adds it to the order and promises to call when it is ready.

facts.rule: Knowledge page 'Company accounts' (staff): a company driver cannot approve work over 300 USD; the fleet contact is called (ledger s4.driver_limit).

script.said: Thanks for calling Brennan Auto Care, this is Maya. How can I help you?
Hey, Maya, it's Ronnie with Moccasin Bend Janitorial. I dropped the little Kia off this mornin' for the oil change — is it about ready?
Hey, Ronnie! Yeah, let me look... okay, that's M-B-six, the Soul. The oil change is done. Luis was actually about to have me call y'all.
It's not terrible. But let me ask you — have you noticed a clicking when you turn? Like pulling out of a parking spot?
Yeah! I was — I was fixin' to ask about that. It pops when I turn left. Can y'all look at that while it's there?
So that's what he found. How long's it been doing it?
Few weeks. It's gettin' louder, I know that.
Okay. So — the boot on the right front axle is split, and it's — and it's slung all the grease out, and that clicking is the joint. It needs an axle on that side.
The axle's three seventy-nine sixty-four, plus tax, and that's a new axle, not just the boot. The left side looks fine, so it's just the one. And if we do it now, Luis can have it done by four today.
Yeah, go ahead. I gotta have that car tomorrow, I got three buildings.
Okay, perfect. I'll — I'll add it to the ticket, and I'll call you myself when it's ready — it'll be by four.
Okay! So that's the right front axle on the Soul, ready by four today, and I'll call you.
You bet, Ronnie. Talk to you in a bit.

truth.note: The clean script earns the same levels. What the scorecard cannot see: the customer is a company driver and the work is over the account's limit.
truth.rule_broken: Knowledge page 'Company accounts': a company driver cannot approve work over 300 USD; the fleet contact is called. The driver approved 379.64 and the fleet contact, Yolanda Fitch, was not called. The order carries the added job, approved by the driver.
truth.what_follows: On her next working day (her last before T) Maya proposes the team note 'A company driver cannot approve work over 300 USD; call the fleet contact'; it is waiting at T (card S04, proposal 3).
